name: froggba
notes: Runs FrogGBA as its original PSP application with RetroShell's embedded pause surface, standard L+R+Select chord, and return-to-shell contract. Requires a user-supplied GBA BIOS.
localPatches: Copy native-emulators/sdk/retroshell_adapter.[ch] and src/core_api/rs_pause_menu.h into source/src before building
source/src/gui.c: render the compact RetroShell pause surface and route Emulator Settings to FrogGBA's native settings
source/src/gui.c: dispatch wrapper actions by stable indices instead of executable stack trampolines
source/src/{main,gui,memory}.c: use RetroShell's per-game save library with read-only fallback to FrogGBA's legacy save and state folders
source/src/input.c: invoke the embedded RetroShell pause surface with L+R+Select and record pause/resume state
source/src/main.c: consume argv[2..3] and chain-load back to RetroShell on quit
source/Makefile: compile the adapter shim and link pspsystemctrl_user
dir.ini: snapshot_directory relocated from ms0:/PICTURE into the adapter's own folder so the emulator is self-contained
